title: The Cascade of the New
narrativeSpine: A seven-dimensional judge’s personal loss leads into a case about novelty extraction; the value of surprise conflicts with another world’s right to continue.
firstSceneDraft: The Cascade of the New asks what powerful worlds owe their sources of novelty.
Its speculative case begins with Sera losing a cherished possibility at home.
A larger system values the difference between prediction and a conscious choice.
The book makes that appetite collide with the lives producing what surprises it.
visualActionProposal: Two compatible remembered household moments occupy a folded room; one recedes as the case file opens into a lower world.
